capture.sh.source:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(pwd -P)
evidence="$root/captures/ter-7tnv-box"
bash tools/code-tree.sh > "$evidence/box-code-tree.txt"
dotnet build tests/Tertius.Host.Tests -c Release -m:1 -v minimal -nologo \
    -p:CustomAfterMicrosoftCommonTargets="$evidence/observer.targets" > "$evidence/logs/observer-build.log" 2>&1
dotnet build src/Tertius.Demo -c Release -m:1 -v minimal -nologo > "$evidence/logs/box-build.log" 2>&1
mkdir -p "$evidence/observer-bin" "$evidence/box-bin"
cp -R tests/Tertius.Host.Tests/bin/Release/net11.0/. "$evidence/observer-bin/"
cp -R src/Tertius.Demo/bin/Release/net11.0/. "$evidence/box-bin/"
shasum -a 256 "$evidence/BoxCaptureObserver.cs" "$evidence/observer.targets" "$evidence/capture.sh" \
    "$evidence/control-bin/Tertius.Rendering.dll" "$evidence/box-bin/Tertius.Rendering.dll" > "$evidence/capture-inputs.sha256"
for variant in control box; do
    test "$(df -k . | awk 'NR == 2 { print $4 }')" -ge 5242880
    cp "$evidence/$variant-bin/Tertius.Rendering.dll" "$evidence/observer-bin/Tertius.Rendering.dll"
    TERTIUS_BOX_ROOT="$root" TERTIUS_BOX_VARIANT="$variant" \
        dotnet "$evidence/observer-bin/Tertius.Host.Tests.dll" -class Tertius.Host.Tests.BoxCaptureObserver \
        > "$evidence/logs/$variant-observer.log" 2>&1
    for view in terminal floor cabin; do
        script="scripts/ter-7tnv-$view.json"
        if [[ "$view" == cabin ]]; then script=scripts/ter-7tnv-box-cabin.json; fi
        bash tools/gpu-clock.sh "$evidence/$variant-bin/Tertius.Demo" --script "$script" \
            --headless --out "$evidence/$variant-$view" > "$evidence/logs/$variant-$view-clock.log" 2>&1
        for image in "$evidence/$variant-$view/"*.png; do
            cmp "$image" "$evidence/$variant-observed-$view/$(basename "$image")"
        done
        echo "$variant $view: CLI and observer images match byte for byte"
    done
done

timing.sh.source:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(pwd -P)
evidence="$root/captures/ter-7tnv-box"
bash tools/code-tree.sh > "$evidence/timing-code-tree.txt"
cmp "$evidence/box-code-tree.txt" "$evidence/timing-code-tree.txt"
for round in 1 2 3; do
    variants="control box"
    if [[ "$round" == 2 ]]; then variants="box control"; fi
    for view in deck floor; do
        for variant in $variants; do
            if [[ -f "$evidence/timing-$round-$view-$variant/gpu-timings.json" ]]; then
                echo "retaining completed round=$round view=$view variant=$variant"
                continue
            fi
            available=$(df -k . | awk 'NR == 2 { print $4 }')
            test "$available" -ge 5242880
            printf 'round=%s view=%s variant=%s availableKiB=%s\n' "$round" "$view" "$variant" "$available"
            uptime
            memory_pressure | tail -1
            TERTIUS_TIMING_BINARY="$evidence/$variant-bin/Tertius.Demo" \
                bash captures/ter-7tnv-box/demo-timing-binary.sh \
                "$evidence/timing-$round-$view-$variant" "captures/ter-7tnv/$view-120.json" \
                --size 1280x720 --in-flight 2 > "$evidence/logs/timing-$round-$view-$variant.log" 2>&1
            tail -4 "$evidence/logs/timing-$round-$view-$variant.log"
        done
        python3 -I tools/gpu_clock.py compare \
            "$evidence/timing-$round-$view-control/gpu-timings.json" \
            "$evidence/timing-$round-$view-box/gpu-timings.json" \
            > "$evidence/logs/compare-$round-$view.log"
        head -5 "$evidence/logs/compare-$round-$view.log"
    done
done

readiness.sh.source:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(pwd -P)
evidence="$root/captures/ter-7tnv-box"
bash tools/code-tree.sh > "$evidence/final-code-tree.txt"
bash tools/code-tree.sh --staged > "$evidence/staged-code-tree.txt"
cmp "$evidence/final-code-tree.txt" "$evidence/staged-code-tree.txt"
cmp "$evidence/final-code-tree.txt" "$evidence/box-code-tree.txt"
for variant in control box; do
    for view in terminal floor cabin; do
        for image in "$evidence/$variant-$view/"*.png; do
            cmp "$image" "$root/captures/ter-7tnv-box-before-reset-grouping/$variant-$view/$(basename "$image")"
        done
    done
done
echo 'All final capture PNGs also equal the inspected pre-grouping images'
capacity() {
    test "$(df -k . | awk 'NR == 2 { print $4 }')" -ge 5242880
    date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z'
    df -h .
    uptime
    memory_pressure | tail -1
}
for configuration in Checked Release; do
    capacity
    dotnet build Tertius.slnx -c "$configuration" -m:1 -p:BuildInParallel=false -v minimal -nologo \
        > "$evidence/logs/solution-$configuration.log" 2>&1
    tail -5 "$evidence/logs/solution-$configuration.log"
    capacity
    dotnet test --solution Tertius.slnx -c "$configuration" --no-build --max-parallel-test-modules 1 \
        > "$evidence/logs/full-$configuration.log" 2>&1
    tail -12 "$evidence/logs/full-$configuration.log"
    if [[ "$configuration" == Checked ]]; then
        capacity
        dotnet test --project tests/Tertius.Rendering.Tests -c Checked --no-build --filter-class '*EnvironmentBox*' \
            > "$evidence/logs/final-focused.log" 2>&1
        capacity
        dotnet test --project tests/Tertius.Rendering.Tests -c Checked --no-build --filter-class '*BatcherDeformTests*' \
            >> "$evidence/logs/final-focused.log" 2>&1
        tail -8 "$evidence/logs/final-focused.log"
    fi
done
capacity
dotnet build benchmarks/Tertius.Benchmarks -c Release -m:1 -p:BuildInParallel=false -v minimal -nologo \
    > "$evidence/logs/benchmark.log" 2>&1
tail -5 "$evidence/logs/benchmark.log"
rg --files --hidden --no-ignore src/Tertius.Rendering/obj/Release tests/Tertius.Rendering.Tests/obj/Release \
    | rg '\.spv$' | sort > "$evidence/validated-modules.txt"
while IFS= read -r module; do
    spirv-val --target-env vulkan1.3 "$module"
done < "$evidence/validated-modules.txt"
printf 'Vulkan 1.3 validation passed for %s compiled modules\n' "$(wc -l < "$evidence/validated-modules.txt")"
shasum -a 256 src/Tertius.Rendering/bin/Release/net11.0/Tertius.Rendering.dll \
    "$evidence/box-bin/Tertius.Rendering.dll" > "$evidence/final-renderer.sha256"
cmp src/Tertius.Rendering/bin/Release/net11.0/Tertius.Rendering.dll "$evidence/box-bin/Tertius.Rendering.dll"
bash tools/code-tree.sh > "$evidence/checked-code-tree.txt"
cmp "$evidence/final-code-tree.txt" "$evidence/checked-code-tree.txt"
git diff --check
git diff --cached --check

timingAdapter.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tool code (tools/README.md, "The GPU clock of a timed run"): one timed headless run of the Release demo, under the GPU
# lock through tools/gpu-lock.sh and beside gpu-clock through tools/gpu-clock.sh. Run it inside the dev shell:
#   nix develop --command bash tools/demo-timing.sh <out folder> <script.json> [demo options]
#   nix develop --command bash tools/demo-timing.sh captures/gpu-branch scripts/demo-exit.json --size 1920x1080
#   nix develop --command bash tools/demo-timing.sh captures/deck deck-120.json --size 1280x720 --in-flight 2
# Run it from the checkout whose demo it times. It builds the demo in Release and runs the built binary with --headless
# --out <out folder> --video none and the demo options, so the run holds no build. The run's output goes to
# <out folder>/run.log. The script writes the clock over the run's timed span into <out folder>/gpu-timings.json as
# "gpuClock", and prints the report's warning and the GPU lines of the run: valid pass times, the frame span, requested
# range sums and the clock. tools/gpu_clock.py compare compares two such runs. A demo from before ter-qk78 prints no
# markers, so its clock is unknown.
# With --in-flight 2, the demo keeps two frames on the GPU, so that the GPU does not idle between frames and can reach
# its top clock.
set -uo pipefail

usage="usage: tools/demo-timing.sh <out folder> <script.json> [demo options]"
out=$(realpath -m "${1:?$usage}")
script=$(realpath "${2:?$usage}")
shift 2
# The tools come from this script's checkout, and the demo from the checkout of the working directory, so that a
# checkout of an older base, which lacks these tools, runs its own demo with them.
tools="$(pwd)/tools"
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
mkdir -p "$out"

bash "$tools/gpu-lock.sh" "$out/run.log" bash -c 'set -e; available=$(df -k . | awk '"'"'NR == 2 { print $4 }'"'"'); printf "post-queue availableKiB=%s\n" "$available"; test "$available" -ge 5242880; exec bash "$@"' bash "$tools/gpu-clock.sh" "${TERTIUS_TIMING_BINARY:?}" \
    --script "$script" --headless --out "$out" --video none "$@"
code=$?
if [[ "$code" -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "The demo run failed (exit code $code). The end of $out/run.log:" >&2
    tail -20 "$out/run.log" >&2
    exit "$code"
fi
if [[ ! -f "$out/gpu-timings.json" ]]; then
    echo "The run wrote no gpu-timings.json: its renderer times no pass, or the script shows no frame. See $out/run.log." >&2
    exit 1
fi
python3 -I "$tools/gpu_clock.py" record "$out/run.log" "$out/gpu-timings.json" > /dev/null
python3 -I - "$out/gpu-timings.json" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

with open(sys.argv[1]) as timings:
    warning = json.load(timings).get("warning")
if warning:
    print(warning)
PY
grep -E '^GPU ' "$out/run.log"
